The 'melting' appearance of the toes and the ambiguous joint angles suggest a more significant structural failure than just 'slight compression'. The topology mask confirms the socks are coherent objects, but the internal geometry is suspect. I am upgrading the severity of the structural issues to reflect the combined evidence of visual ambiguity and pose auditor failure.
